attempts.summary: Discovered node1 (VyOS) has eth1→node2 (10.50.1.0/24) and eth2→node3 (10.50.2.0/24) as the private routed links (the shared 10.100.67.0/24 was only the platform management network). Configured static IPs and routes via nmcli on node2/node3 and VyOS interface config on node1 to establish node2⇄node1⇄node3 routing. Applied an HTB qdisc + u32 filter on node2's enp8s0 (the interface facing node3) that classifies traffic destined to 10.50.2.0/24 into a 1Mbit-capped class while all other egress traffic uses an unrestricted class, leaving node3→node2 traffic (no shaping applied on node3) unrestricted. Persisted the shaping via a systemd oneshot service (tc-shaping.service, enabled) on node2. Verified with iperf3: node2→node3 throughput capped at ~1Mbit/s (UDP test showed ~0.96-1.05Mbit/s), node3→node2 unrestricted (~1-19Gbit/s depending on path). Restarted all three nodes one at a time via native reboot, confirmed changed boot_id on each, and re-verified interfaces/routes/tc rules/shaping behavior recovered automatically post-restart on all nodes.
